description: Search threads in a channel by name, tags, and time bounds. New threads take about 30 seconds to appear in search results. Returns matched threads, first messages, and member objects. Page results with offset=next_offset. To browse active threads without indexing delays, use discord_list_active_guild_threads. Bot permissions it may need: Read Message History. Read-only; safe to retry.

archived.description: Filter by archive state: true for archived only, false for active only

channel_id.description: ID of the parent channel to search threads in

limit.description: Maximum number of threads to return per page (1-25)

max_id.description: Filter threads created before this snowflake ID

min_id.description: Filter threads created after this snowflake ID

name.description: Query string to search thread names for

offset.description: Offset index into the search results for pagination; page with next_offset

slop.description: Slop parameter controlling phrase matching fuzziness (0-100)

tag.description: Filter by up to 20 forum tag IDs applied to threads

items.description: Discord snowflake ID as a numeric string

tag_setting.description: How tag matches combine: 'match_all' requires a thread to have every tag in tag, 'match_some' requires at least one
